name: TransOSS ViT-B/16 optical-SAR scene-pair pretraining
use: Paired scene initialization for author TransOSS contest adaptation; full download, strict GPU loading and local holdout training verified

weights.format: PyTorch checkpoint; use torch.load(weights_only=True), never unrestricted pickle execution

attribution: Han Wang et al., Cross-modal Ship Re-Identification via Optical and SAR Imagery: A Novel Dataset and Method, ICCV 2025; https://github.com/Alioth2000/Hoss-ReID
training_provenance: Author describes SEN1-2/DFC23 scene-pair pretraining initialized from ImageNet ViT. This is vit_b512_pre.pth, not HOSS_TransOSS.pth trained with ship identities. Exact checkpoint training data not independently audited.
integration_constraints: Use the reviewed author ViT architecture and strictly load every backbone tensor.
Use modality information supplied by task.json; do not infer it from grayscale appearance.
Disable physical size/GSD embeddings; competition images do not provide valid physical metadata.
Disclose source, fixed version, license, attribution and changes in reproduction materials.
Do not import HOSS hidden/test identity annotations or use identity-trained checkpoints without checking data overlap and rules.

download_verified.transport: public mirror ranged download, incomplete ranges repaired in 1 MiB pieces
download_verified.metadata_inspection_only: pickle opcodes inspected without executing pickle; pos_embed shape 1x129x768, both patch stems and mie_embed present

integration_verified.backbone_load: all backbone tensors loaded strictly with weights_only=True
integration_verified.position_grid_adaptation: 16x8 to 16x16 bilinear interpolation; no physical-scale metadata

eligibility_scope: Reviewed public dates, declared licenses and actual strict architecture loading; local holdout score is not an official competition score or organizer-specific resource approval.
